Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a report of a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas. On arrival, Driver 1 and Driver 2
were standing beside their vehicles, and Passenger was seated in the front of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a
knee injury and said the knee struck the dashboard during the impact. Driver 2 stated that the vehicles collided after
both drivers slowed for traffic ahead. Officers reviewed scene photographs, which confirm the positions of both
vehicles and the location of the damage. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with the impact described by the
drivers. Passenger and Driver 1 were both present in the vehicle at the time of the collision, as confirmed by officers
on scene and by statements from the parties involved. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 1 is listed as
the named insured on the policy for the vehicle involved. No prior damage to either vehicle was reported or observed.
Whether the reported knee injury resulted from this collision has not yet been determined and will require further
medical review.
</page>
